strategy.name: Aggressive Momentum (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium-hold momentum and breakout trades in high-beta, liquid large/mid-cap stocks and broad ETFs. Rides relative strength with trailing stops; cuts losers fast. Aggressive sizing inside hard guardrails — paper only.
rules: Enter on 2+ triggers: breakout, momentum leader, oversold snapback, near-term catalyst, or sector thesis conviction.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), then apply NEUTRAL regime 25% size trim, cap at 30% of equity per name.
Set ~20% trailing stop on every entry. Never remove a stop.
Cut at −12% from entry unless dated catalyst is imminent and thesis intact.
No new entries if daily loss halt (−8%) is hit; stand down for the month at −25% MTD.
Universe: liquid US large/mid-cap stocks + broad/sector ETFs. No leveraged ETFs, crypto, penny stocks (<$10), or meme names.
